scope: M12.0 original SVG design concepts, browser rendering only
corrections: Settings uses its own navigation and Settings icon, rather than a Files toolbar/sidebar.
Unavailable USB commands are visually muted; an empty provider retains Back, address and sidebar.
Distinct Calculator, Calendar and Clock silhouettes replace identical letter tiles.
limitations: Concepts are fixed 1280 by 800 logical-pixel diagrams, not native scale or 4K qualification.
Sample filenames, progress and timestamps illustrate states, not new provider capabilities.
Native implementation, input, performance and media qualification follow in subsequent stages.
